content.short: Farcaster is an open protocol that operates a decentralized social network.
content.description: Farcaster is a fully decentralized social network and open protocol that supports multiple clients. It lets users migrate their social identities across applications, while developers can build new features on the network. On Farcaster, you can send short text broadcasts linked to your Ethereum address, enabling verifiable identity. Verifying address ownership unlocks features such as showcasing your NFT and using your NFT as a verified avatar, among other capabilities, creating a more interconnected and portable social experience.
